name: file_list
description: List a directory by absolute container path or relative live-checkout path; with pattern (e.g. *composer*), list matching file paths under it recursively. Source writes use isolated broker work automatically. Files are read from the source checkout (/code) and this session's workspace; other container paths, including runtime data, are refused. Reads without a selector inspect published/container files; pass a returned broker_id for private-source reads. Optional broker_id selects current, new or returned work. Explicit runtime/workspace paths retain their owning tools. Never deploys.

task_id.description: Deprecated compatibility alias. Prefer broker_id; do not supply both. Never use a chat session ID here.

broker_id.description: Omit to continue current broker work; new creates independent isolated work in this operation; reuse a returned Broker ID to switch. Session identity is automatic. Never invent an ID.
